title: 張拉膜屋蓋成形~Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
focus: 由預應力平衡求膜面形狀，經雙軸試驗、裁片補償、展開吊升與分階段張拉，把膜屋蓋做成不積水、不鬆弛的曲面~Finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack
summary: 張拉膜沒有抗彎勁度，形狀必須是預應力與邊界共同決定的平衡曲面，因此設計流程從形狀尋找開始，再以膜材雙軸試驗決定勁度與裁片補償，最後在現場展開、吊升並分階段導入預應力。課程以丹佛國際機場 Jeppesen 航廈的雙層 PTFE 屋頂（約 34,800 m² 主屋頂）、吉達哈吉航廈的 210 個錐形膜單元與 Frei Otto 的 1967 年蒙特婁德國館為錨點，說明邊索與膜預應力的關係、積水與雪載、膜材強度折減、補償率誤差、吊升風速、錐形單元頂升、張力量測、顫振、潛變鬆弛與維護交接。~A tensile membrane has no bending stiffness, so its shape must be an equilibrium surface set by prestress and boundaries; design therefore starts with form finding, then uses biaxial fabric tests to set stiffness and pattern compensation, and finally unfolds, hoists and prestresses the membrane on site in stages. Anchored on the double-layer PTFE roof of Denver International Airport's Jeppesen Terminal (about 34,800 m² of main roof), the 210 conical membrane units of the Hajj Terminal in Jeddah and Frei Otto's 1967 German Pavilion in Montreal, the course covers edge-cable and prestress relations, ponding and snow, fabric strength reduction, compensation errors, hoisting wind limits, jacking of conical units, tension measurement, flutter, creep relaxation and maintenance handover.

units.anchor: 邊索垂度與膜預應力~Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress
units.title: 形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫~Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape
units.mechanism: 膜材只能受拉，若要在無外載時保持光滑無皺，膜面上每一點都必須處於預應力平衡。在等向均勻預應力下，平衡曲面就是肥皂膜那樣的極小曲面，兩個主曲率大小相等、方向相反；改變邊界點高度、邊索張力或不同方向的預應力比值，就會得到不同的平衡形狀。自由邊緣的邊索受膜拉力而形成圓弧，其曲率半徑等於邊索張力除以膜預應力，因此邊索垂度、邊索張力與膜預應力是一組必須同時決定的設計參數。~A membrane works only in tension, so to stay smooth and wrinkle-free without load every point of its surface must be in prestress equilibrium. Under uniform isotropic prestress the equilibrium surface is a minimal surface like a soap film, with equal and opposite principal curvatures; changing boundary heights, edge-cable tension or the prestress ratio between directions produces different equilibrium shapes. A free edge cable pulled by the membrane forms a circular arc whose radius equals cable tension divided by membrane prestress, so edge sag, edge-cable force and membrane prestress form a set of design parameters that must be chosen together.
units.model: 邊索曲率半徑 R = T/t。邊索張力 T = 150 kN、膜預應力 t = 3 kN/m，R = 50 m；弦長 c = 20 m 時邊索垂度 f ≈ c²/(8R) = 400/400 = 1.0 m，約為弦長 5%。若想把垂度增為 2.0 m，在 t 不變下 T 需降為約 75 kN。數值為教學假設。~Edge-cable radius R = T/t. With cable tension T = 150 kN and membrane prestress t = 3 kN/m, R = 50 m; over a chord c = 20 m the edge sag is f ≈ c²/(8R) = 400/400 = 1.0 m, about 5% of the chord. To deepen the sag to 2.0 m with the same t, T must drop to about 75 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以力密度法、動態鬆弛法或更新參考策略等數值方法求平衡形狀，檢查每個節點殘餘力小於允許值、膜面沒有負應力區；把邊索垂度、預應力比與膜面最小曲率列表，交給建築師確認造型，同時交給結構工程師做荷載分析。~Find the equilibrium shape with a numerical method such as force density, dynamic relaxation or the updated reference strategy, checking that nodal residual forces are below the allowance and no region has negative stress; tabulate edge sags, prestress ratios and minimum surface curvature for the architect to confirm the form and the structural engineer to carry into load analysis.
units.failure: 若建築造型先畫定再要求膜材去配合，畫出的曲面往往不是預應力平衡形狀，現場張拉後出現大片皺褶或局部鬆弛；邊索垂度選得太小，邊索張力與錨點反力急增，桅桿與基礎尺寸也隨之膨脹。~Drawing the architectural form first and asking the fabric to fit usually produces a surface that is not a prestress equilibrium shape, so after tensioning large wrinkles or slack zones appear; choosing too little edge sag makes edge-cable tension and anchor reactions soar, with masts and foundations growing accordingly.
units.misconception: 膜屋蓋的形狀可以像玻璃帷幕一樣由建築師自由決定。~A membrane roof's shape can be set freely by the architect, like a glass façade.
units.practice: 膜結構的設計交付應同時包含平衡形狀、預應力分布與邊索張力表，並寫明所用的形狀尋找方法與收斂準則；建築造型修改後，必須重新做形狀尋找，不得直接拉伸既有曲面。~Membrane design deliverables should include the equilibrium shape, prestress distribution and edge-cable tension table together, stating the form-finding method and convergence criterion; after any change in architectural form, form finding must be redone rather than stretching the existing surface.

units.anchor: 低曲率區與積水~Low-curvature zones and ponding
units.title: 曲率不足、積水與雪載~Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow
units.mechanism: 膜面勁度來自曲率與預應力，平坦區域在雨水或積雪下會大幅下陷，下陷形成窪地又收集更多水或雪，變形持續擴大，這就是漸進式積水。山谷線與低坡度區在融雪與強降雪時最危險；丹佛機場 2003 年 3 月暴風雪期間，大雪在膜頂撕開約 40 ft 的裂口，迫使該區疏散。因此形狀尋找完成後，必須在最不利荷載下檢查變形後的膜面坡度，確認水與雪都能排走，而不只是檢查應力。~Membrane stiffness comes from curvature and prestress, so flat zones sag heavily under rain or snow, the resulting hollow collects more water or snow and deformation keeps growing, the mechanism of progressive ponding. Valley lines and low-slope zones are most at risk during heavy snow and thaw; during the March 2003 blizzard at Denver International Airport, heavy snow tore a gash of about 40 ft in the fabric roof and forced evacuation of that area. After form finding, the deformed surface slope under the worst loads must therefore be checked so water and snow can drain, not stress alone.
units.model: 初始近乎平坦的預應力膜條，在均布荷載 p 下中點下陷 δ ≈ pL²/(8t)。取跨距 L = 6 m、30 mm 積水 p = 0.3 kPa、預應力 t = 4 kN/m：δ ≈ 0.3×36/32 ≈ 0.34 m，已足以形成更大的水窪；t 加倍到 8 kN/m 時 δ ≈ 0.17 m。真正的解法是增加曲率與坡度，而不是只加預應力。數值為教學假設。~An initially near-flat prestressed strip under uniform load p sags at midspan by δ ≈ pL²/(8t). With span L = 6 m, 30 mm of water p = 0.3 kPa and prestress t = 4 kN/m, δ ≈ 0.3×36/32 ≈ 0.34 m, enough to form a larger pond; doubling t to 8 kN/m gives δ ≈ 0.17 m. The real cure is more curvature and slope, not prestress alone. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性分析在雪載、不均勻雪載與積水荷載下求變形後膜面，檢查每個區域的最小坡度與是否出現封閉低點；依當地積雪規範考慮山谷與邊緣的堆積係數；完工後做淋水試驗，觀察水流路徑與停留點。~Compute the deformed surface under snow, unbalanced snow and ponding loads by nonlinear analysis, checking the minimum slope of every zone and whether closed low points appear; apply drift factors for valleys and edges from the local snow code; after completion run a water test to observe flow paths and standing points.
units.failure: 膜面在設計荷載下應力合格，但局部坡度在變形後趨近零，冬季融雪時形成積水，冰水重量持續累積，最後膜材在山谷線或夾具邊緣撕裂；撕裂一旦開始，預應力釋放會讓破口迅速擴大。~A membrane whose stresses pass under design load may still flatten locally to near-zero slope after deformation, ponding during thaw so that ice and water keep accumulating until the fabric tears along a valley or at a clamp edge; once a tear starts, released prestress makes the opening grow quickly.
units.misconception: 只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。~If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem.
units.practice: 膜結構設計基準須明列最小排水坡度、積雪與積水荷載情境，以及營運期間的除雪門檻；對有山谷線或低坡區的設計，應在圖說上標示需要特別監看的區域。~The membrane design basis must state minimum drainage slope, snow and ponding scenarios and the snow-removal threshold for operation; designs with valley lines or low-slope zones should mark the areas needing special monitoring on the drawings.

units.anchor: PTFE 玻纖與 PVC 聚酯膜材~PTFE-glass and PVC-polyester fabrics
units.title: 膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗~Fabric types, strength reduction and biaxial testing
units.mechanism: 常見建築膜材是編織纖維加塗層：PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維耐久、不燃、自潔但怕折；PVC 塗覆聚酯柔軟可折、價格較低但壽命較短；ETFE 則是透明薄膜，常做成充氣枕。編織膜有經向與緯向，兩方向勁度不同，且受拉時經緯紗互相擠壓（捲曲交換），應力應變關係是非線性、雙向耦合的，因此必須以雙軸試驗量測兩方向的勁度與泊松效應，才能用於分析與裁片補償。設計強度則要考慮長期荷載、老化、溫度與接縫等多重折減。~Common architectural fabrics are woven fibres with a coating: PTFE-coated glass is durable, non-combustible and self-cleaning but dislikes folding; PVC-coated polyester is flexible and foldable, cheaper but shorter-lived; ETFE is a transparent foil often used as inflated cushions. Woven fabric has warp and fill directions with different stiffness, and under tension the yarns press on each other (crimp interchange), so the stress–strain relation is nonlinear and coupled in both directions; biaxial tests are therefore needed to measure the stiffness and Poisson effects in both directions for analysis and pattern compensation. Design strength must account for several reductions covering long-term load, ageing, temperature and seams.
units.model: 設計強度 f_d = f_k/(γ_M·k_age·k_temp)。取條帶抗拉強度 f_k = 120 kN/m、材料係數 γ_M = 1.4、老化係數 1.2、溫度係數 1.1：f_d = 120/(1.4×1.2×1.1) ≈ 64.9 kN/m。若再乘接縫效率 0.8，接縫處可用約 51.9 kN/m。係數皆為教學假設，實際應依適用規範取值。~Design strength f_d = f_k/(γ_M·k_age·k_temp). With a strip tensile strength f_k = 120 kN/m, material factor γ_M = 1.4, ageing factor 1.2 and temperature factor 1.1: f_d = 120/(1.4×1.2×1.1) ≈ 64.9 kN/m. With a seam efficiency of 0.8, about 51.9 kN/m is available at seams. All factors are teaching assumptions; real values come from the applicable code.
units.verify: 每批膜材依標準做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗（例如 EN 17117-1 的方法），並以設計預應力比做循環加載求取勁度；接縫做同批材料的熱合強度試驗；所有試驗結果附批號，與裁片補償計算對應。~Test each batch for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, for example by the EN 17117-1 method, using cyclic loading at the design prestress ratio to derive stiffness; test welded seams from the same batch for strength; tag every result with the batch number and link it to the compensation calculation.
units.failure: 以型錄上的單軸強度與典型勁度直接設計，未做該批雙軸試驗，實際膜材比假設更軟或更硬，裁片補償錯誤，張拉後不是鬆弛就是過度受拉；接縫強度不足時，裂口常沿熱合縫開始。~Designing directly from catalogue uniaxial strength and typical stiffness without biaxial tests on the actual batch means the fabric may be softer or stiffer than assumed, compensation is wrong and after tensioning the membrane is either slack or over-stressed; when seam strength is short, tears often start along welded seams.
units.misconception: 膜材只要看單軸拉伸強度就能完成設計。~Uniaxial tensile strength is all that is needed to design with a fabric.
units.practice: 膜材規格應規定強度、雙軸試驗方法與頻率、接縫強度、防火分級與保固年限，並要求供應商提供批號追溯；膜材替代必須重新做雙軸試驗與補償計算，經設計者核可。~The fabric specification should set strength, biaxial test method and frequency, seam strength, fire classification and warranty period, with batch traceability from the supplier; any substitution requires new biaxial tests and compensation calculations approved by the designer.

units.anchor: 裁片圖與補償率~Cutting patterns and compensation
units.title: 從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償~From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns
units.mechanism: 雙曲面無法無變形地攤平，因此要沿測地線等路徑把膜面分成條狀裁片，攤平後再熱合成整片。為了讓膜在安裝後產生設計預應力，裁片必須比平衡形狀上的尺寸略小，這個縮小比例稱為補償率；它由雙軸試驗得到的勁度與預期潛變決定，經緯兩向通常不同。邊界附近則常需要反補償或加長，讓膜能扣上邊索或夾具。補償率錯一點，預應力就差很多，是膜結構成敗最敏感的參數之一。~A doubly curved surface cannot be flattened without distortion, so the membrane is divided into strips along paths such as geodesic lines, flattened and then welded together. For the membrane to develop its design prestress after installation, patterns are cut slightly smaller than their size on the equilibrium shape; this reduction is the compensation, set from biaxial stiffness and expected creep and usually different in warp and fill. Near boundaries de-compensation or extra length is often needed so the fabric can reach edge cables or clamps. A small error in compensation produces a large prestress error, making it one of the most sensitive parameters of a membrane structure.
units.model: 經向勁度 E_w = 1,000 kN/m、目標預應力 4 kN/m，彈性應變 ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.6%：30 m 長的裁片裁成 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m。若補償率誤差 0.3%，長度差 90 mm，預應力誤差約 1,000×0.003 = 3 kN/m，即目標值的 75%。數值為教學假設。~With warp stiffness E_w = 1,000 kN/m and target prestress 4 kN/m, the elastic strain is ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.6% compensation, so a 30 m pattern is cut to 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m. A 0.3% compensation error means a 90 mm length error and a prestress error of about 1,000×0.003 = 3 kN/m, 75% of the target. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 補償率由該批膜材的雙軸試驗推得，計算書寫明經緯兩向數值與潛變假設；裁片後量測對角線與邊長，熱合後量測整片尺寸；必要時先做小型樣片張拉，確認補償後的預應力與預期相符，再大量裁切。~Derive compensation from biaxial tests on the actual batch and state warp and fill values and creep assumptions in the calculations; after cutting measure diagonals and edge lengths, and after welding measure the whole panel; where needed, tension a small sample first to confirm that compensated prestress matches expectation before cutting in quantity.
units.failure: 沿用其他專案或型錄的補償率，實際膜材較軟，安裝後預應力不足、膜面起皺並在風中拍動；補償過大則安裝時必須用很大力量才能扣上邊界，夾具與邊索過載，膜在角隅撕裂。~Reusing compensation from another project or a catalogue for a softer actual fabric leaves prestress short after installation, so the membrane wrinkles and flaps in wind; over-compensation means huge force is needed to reach the boundary, overloading clamps and edge cables and tearing the fabric at corners.
units.misconception: 裁片只要照曲面展開的尺寸裁切即可，不需要補償。~Patterns are simply cut to the flattened surface size; no compensation is needed.
units.practice: 裁片圖每一片都要標示經緯方向、補償率、熱合邊與編號，並與試驗批號連結；補償率屬設計參數，任何更改須由膜結構設計者書面核可，裁片廠不得自行調整。~Every pattern should show warp and fill direction, compensation, weld allowances and panel number, linked to the test batch; compensation is a design parameter, so any change requires the membrane designer's written approval and must not be adjusted by the fabricator.

units.anchor: 膜片展開與吊升~Panel unfolding and hoisting
units.title: 膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制~Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels
units.mechanism: 大型膜片在工廠熱合後捲起或摺疊運到現場：PTFE 玻纖膜要用大直徑捲筒且不得對折，PVC 聚酯膜較能摺疊。現場在清潔平台或索網上展開，以分散的夾具與吊樑吊升，並儘快連接到邊界。展開中的大片膜像帆一樣受風，數百平方公尺的膜片在中等風速下就能產生數十 kN 的力，遠超過工人能抓住的程度，因此展開與吊升必須在低風速時段、依預定順序並以臨時固定措施進行。~Large panels are rolled or folded after factory welding and shipped to site: PTFE-glass needs large-diameter rolls and must never be folded double, while PVC-polyester tolerates folding better. On site the panel is unfolded on a clean platform or over the cable net, hoisted with distributed clamps and spreader beams and connected to its boundaries as soon as possible. An unfolding panel catches wind like a sail; a panel of several hundred square metres develops tens of kilonewtons in moderate wind, far beyond what a crew can hold, so unfolding and hoisting must be done in low-wind windows, in a planned sequence, with temporary restraints.
units.model: 500 m² 的膜片在 10 m/s 風中，q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa，取阻力係數 1.2，F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN；風速降到 8 m/s 時約 23.5 kN。由於 F 與 V² 成正比，把作業風速上限由 10 m/s 降到 8 m/s，風力約減少 36%。面積與係數為教學假設。~A 500 m² panel in 10 m/s wind has q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa; with a drag coefficient of 1.2, F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN, falling to about 23.5 kN at 8 m/s. Because F scales with V², lowering the working wind limit from 10 to 8 m/s reduces the force by about 36%. Area and coefficient are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 到貨時檢查捲筒直徑、包裝與膜面是否有折痕或塗層損傷；展開前確認平台或索網表面無尖銳物，風速計設在作業高度並持續記錄；每一片膜的吊點、夾具與臨時固定位置依安裝計畫核對，連接邊界後才解除臨時固定。~On arrival check roll diameter, packaging and the fabric for creases or coating damage; before unfolding confirm the platform or net has no sharp objects, with an anemometer at working height logging continuously; check each panel's pick points, clamps and temporary restraints against the installation plan, and release temporary restraints only after connection to the boundary.
units.failure: 在陣風中展開膜片，膜被風鼓起拖動工人與夾具，造成人員受傷與膜材撕裂；PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被對折，玻纖斷裂留下看不見的弱線，安裝後數年在反覆風載下沿折線撕開。~Unfolding a panel in gusts lets it billow and drag workers and clamps, injuring people and tearing fabric; a PTFE-glass panel folded double in handling breaks glass fibres along an invisible weak line that tears years later under repeated wind.
units.misconception: 膜材很輕，安裝時一點風不會有影響。~Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation.
units.practice: 安裝計畫須列出每片膜的展開順序、吊點與夾具配置、作業風速上限、臨時固定與緊急收膜程序，並由膜結構承包商與結構設計者共同核可；高空與吊掛作業須由合格人員依核准程序執行，本課只說明檢核邏輯。~The installation plan must list each panel's unfolding sequence, pick points and clamps, working wind limit, temporary restraint and emergency recovery procedure, approved jointly by the membrane contractor and structural designer; work at height and lifting must be done by qualified personnel under approved procedures, and this course explains checking logic only.

units.anchor: 錐形單元頂環頂升~Jacking the ring of conical units
units.title: 分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環~Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings
units.mechanism: 膜面接上邊界後仍是鬆弛的，要靠拉緊邊索、頂升桅桿或吊起頂環，把膜拉長到補償後的尺寸，才產生設計預應力。哈吉航廈的每個錐形單元由頂環向下輻射，周邊固定在桅桿網格上，這類錐形單元的預應力主要靠把頂環吊升到設計高度產生。張拉要分階段、對稱地進行：一次把某一邊拉到位，膜會在另一邊起皺甚至撕裂，邊索與夾具受力也不均。每一階段都要量測幾何與張力，確認與分析一致後再繼續。~Once connected to its boundaries a membrane is still slack; tightening edge cables, jacking masts or lifting rings stretches it to its compensated size and creates the design prestress. Each conical unit of the Hajj Terminal radiates down from a top ring with its perimeter fixed to the pylon grid, and in such conical units prestress comes mainly from lifting the ring to its design height. Tensioning must proceed in stages and symmetrically: pulling one side fully at once wrinkles or even tears the other side and loads edge cables and clamps unevenly. Geometry and tension are measured at each stage and the work continues only when they agree with the analysis.
units.model: 錐形單元底半徑 r = 22.4 m、高 H = 20 m，斜長 L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m。目標預應力 5 kN/m、膜勁度 800 kN/m，所需應變 0.625%，斜向伸長約 30.0×0.00625 ≈ 0.19 m；頂環提升 Δh 時斜長增加約 Δh·H/L = 0.667Δh，故 Δh ≈ 0.19/0.667 ≈ 0.28 m。幾何與勁度為教學假設。~A conical unit with base radius r = 22.4 m and height H = 20 m has a slant length L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m. For a target prestress of 5 kN/m and fabric stiffness 800 kN/m the strain is 0.625%, a slant extension of about 30.0×0.00625 ≈ 0.19 m; raising the ring by Δh lengthens the slant by about Δh·H/L = 0.667Δh, so Δh ≈ 0.19/0.667 ≈ 0.28 m. Geometry and stiffness are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 張拉計畫依分析列出每階段的頂升量或邊索伸長與預期張力，每階段量測頂環高程、邊索張力與膜面皺褶分布；最後一階段以膜張力計抽查各區預應力，並與目標值比較（例如允許 ±15%），記錄當時溫度。~The tensioning plan lists, from the analysis, the jacking height or edge-cable extension and expected tension at each stage; at each stage measure ring level, edge-cable tension and wrinkle pattern; at the final stage spot-check prestress in each zone with a membrane tensiometer against the target, for example within ±15%, recording the temperature.
units.failure: 為了趕工把頂環一次頂到位，膜面在頂環附近應力集中而沿熱合縫撕裂；只依頂升量控制而不量張力，若補償率有誤，頂升量正確但預應力完全不對。~Jacking a ring to full height in one go to save time concentrates stress around the ring and tears the fabric along welded seams; controlling by jacking height alone without measuring tension means that, if compensation is wrong, the height is right but the prestress is not.
units.misconception: 膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。~Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning.
units.practice: 張拉程序書須列出階段、對稱順序、每階段目標與允許偏差、停止條件與量測方法，由結構設計者簽認；張拉屬高能量作業，須設警戒區並由合格人員依核准程序執行。~The tensioning procedure must list stages, symmetric order, target and tolerance per stage, stop conditions and measurement methods, signed by the structural designer; tensioning is high-energy work requiring an exclusion zone and qualified personnel under an approved procedure.

units.anchor: 膜張力計與皺褶檢查~Membrane tensiometer and wrinkle check
units.title: 安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收~Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance
units.mechanism: 膜的預應力無法像索那樣用千斤頂直接讀出，現場常用膜張力計：在膜面上兩支點之間施加一個小力，量測膜面的局部撓度，由幾何關係反算該方向的單位寬度張力。量測要在經向與緯向分別進行，並涵蓋高曲率區、低曲率區與邊界附近。皺褶的方向也是線索：皺褶平行於受拉方向，垂直於鬆弛方向。驗收結果應建立為基準，日後潛變與鬆弛都以此比較。~Membrane prestress cannot be read directly from a jack as with cables, so a membrane tensiometer is used on site: a small force is applied between two supports on the surface, the local deflection measured and the tension per unit width back-calculated from the geometry. Measurements are taken separately in warp and fill and cover high-curvature zones, low-curvature zones and areas near boundaries. Wrinkle direction is also a clue: wrinkles run parallel to the tensioned direction and across the slack one. Acceptance results become the baseline against which later creep and relaxation are compared.
units.model: 簡化弦模型：支點間距 a = 200 mm、量測寬度 b = 50 mm，在中點施加 F = 20 N 得撓度 δ = 5 mm，單位寬度張力 t ≈ F·a/(4·b·δ) = 20×200/(4×50×5) = 4 N/mm = 4 kN/m。若 δ 量成 6 mm，t ≈ 3.3 kN/m；撓度量測誤差 1 mm 就造成約 17% 的張力差。儀器尺寸與讀數為教學假設。~A simple string model: with support spacing a = 200 mm and measuring width b = 50 mm, a midpoint force F = 20 N giving deflection δ = 5 mm means a tension per unit width t ≈ F·a/(4·b·δ) = 20×200/(4×50×5) = 4 N/mm = 4 kN/m. If δ reads 6 mm, t ≈ 3.3 kN/m, so a 1 mm deflection error gives about 17% tension difference. Instrument dimensions and readings are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 膜張力計先在已知張力的試驗架上校正；現場依網格選點，經緯向各量一次並記錄溫度、日照與風況；結果與分析預測比較，偏差超過允許值的區域再加密量測，並以皺褶照片佐證。~Calibrate the tensiometer on a test rig with known tension first; on site measure at gridded points in both warp and fill, recording temperature, sun and wind; compare results with predictions and densify measurements where deviations exceed the allowance, supported by photographs of wrinkles.
units.failure: 在午後日照下量測，膜溫升高使張力下降，被誤判為預應力不足而過度張拉，到了冬季膜材過度受拉；只量少數點而忽略邊界附近，邊緣鬆弛在風中拍動，磨損夾具與膜材。~Measuring in afternoon sun, when warm fabric loses tension, can be misread as low prestress and lead to over-tensioning, leaving the fabric over-stressed in winter; measuring only a few points and ignoring boundaries misses slack edges that flap in wind and wear clamps and fabric.
units.misconception: 膜面看起來平整沒有皺褶，就表示預應力正確。~If a membrane looks smooth without wrinkles, its prestress must be correct.
units.practice: 驗收計畫要明列量測點位、方法、儀器校正、溫度條件與允許偏差；量測紀錄與照片作為維護基準移交業主，日後複測須用同一方法與點位。~The acceptance plan must state measuring points, method, instrument calibration, temperature conditions and tolerance; records and photographs are handed to the owner as the maintenance baseline, and later re-measurement must use the same method and points.

units.anchor: 膜面振動與排水試驗~Fabric vibration and drainage test
units.title: 顫振、拍動與排水的完工驗證~Completion checks for flutter, flapping and drainage
units.mechanism: 膜面質量極輕、阻尼低，自然頻率由預應力與跨距決定，在陣風中容易振動；當膜與周圍空氣耦合，附加空氣質量會降低頻率，嚴重時出現拍動甚至氣動不穩定。完工驗證因此包括兩件事：確認膜面在常見風況下不出現持續大幅拍動（必要時增加預應力或加設谷索），以及以淋水試驗確認排水路徑、落水口與山谷線沒有積水點。丹佛機場這類大面積雙層膜屋頂，還要檢查內外膜之間的通風與冷凝。~A membrane is extremely light with low damping, and its natural frequency depends on prestress and span, so it vibrates readily in gusts; coupling with the surrounding air adds mass and lowers the frequency, and in severe cases causes flapping or aeroelastic instability. Completion verification therefore covers two things: confirming that the surface does not flap persistently in common winds, adding prestress or valley cables if necessary, and water-testing drainage paths, outlets and valley lines for standing water. Large double-layer roofs such as Denver's also need checks on ventilation and condensation between inner and outer membranes.
units.model: 膜條基頻 f = (1/2L)·√(t/m)。跨距 L = 6 m、預應力 t = 4,000 N/m、膜質量加附加空氣質量 m = 2.5 kg/m²：f = (1/12)·√(4,000/2.5) = (1/12)×40 ≈ 3.3 Hz；預應力加倍到 8,000 N/m，f ≈ 4.7 Hz，提高約 41%。附加空氣質量為教學假設。~The fundamental frequency of a membrane strip is f = (1/2L)·√(t/m). With span L = 6 m, prestress t = 4,000 N/m and fabric plus added air mass m = 2.5 kg/m², f = (1/12)·√(4,000/2.5) = (1/12)×40 ≈ 3.3 Hz; doubling prestress to 8,000 N/m gives f ≈ 4.7 Hz, about 41% higher. The added air mass is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以加速度計或雷射位移計量測代表性膜區在環境風下的頻率與振幅，與計算比較；觀察強風時是否有持續拍動或噪音；淋水試驗記錄水流路徑、落水口流量與停留點，並在兩層膜之間檢查冷凝與排水。~Measure frequency and amplitude of representative membrane zones under ambient wind with accelerometers or laser displacement sensors and compare with calculation; observe for persistent flapping or noise in strong wind; record flow paths, outlet flows and standing points in a water test, and inspect condensation and drainage between the two membrane layers.
units.failure: 預應力偏低的膜區在風中長期拍動，膜材在夾具邊緣反覆彎折而疲勞撕裂，同時產生擾人的噪音；排水口被落葉堵塞而無人檢查，積水把膜面壓出更深的窪地，形成前述的漸進式積水。~A low-prestress zone flapping in wind for years fatigues and tears the fabric through repeated bending at clamp edges while creating disturbing noise; outlets blocked by leaves and left unchecked let water press the surface into deeper hollows, the progressive ponding described earlier.
units.misconception: 膜屋蓋很輕，風只會讓它輕輕晃動，不會造成損壞。~A membrane roof is so light that wind only makes it sway gently without damage.
units.practice: 完工驗收應包括振動量測與淋水試驗，並把拍動區域、排水口與山谷線列入維護巡檢清單；若需加設谷索或調整預應力，須由結構設計者重新分析後才可施作。~Completion acceptance should include vibration measurement and a water test, with flapping zones, outlets and valley lines put on the maintenance inspection list; adding valley cables or adjusting prestress requires fresh analysis by the structural designer before work.

units.anchor: 潛變鬆弛與再張拉~Creep relaxation and re-tensioning
units.title: 膜材潛變、預應力流失與再張拉~Fabric creep, prestress loss and re-tensioning
units.mechanism: 膜材在長期預應力下會持續伸長，PVC 聚酯膜尤其明顯，PTFE 玻纖膜較小但並非沒有；伸長使預應力逐漸流失，膜面開始起皺、拍動並在積水與雪載下變形加大。因此設計時要預留潛變補償，並在邊界設計可再張拉的機構（可調邊索端、可頂升的桅桿或頂環），讓營運單位在首年與之後定期檢查時恢復預應力。膜材老化、破口與修補（PTFE 可熱合補片）也都要納入維護計畫。~Fabric keeps stretching under long-term prestress, markedly so for PVC-polyester and less, but not negligibly, for PTFE-glass; the stretch gradually loses prestress, and the membrane begins to wrinkle, flap and deform more under ponding and snow. Design must therefore allow for creep in compensation and provide re-tensioning devices at the boundaries, such as adjustable edge-cable ends, jackable masts or rings, so the operator can restore prestress in the first year and at later inspections. Ageing, holes and repairs, such as heat-welded patches on PTFE, belong in the maintenance plan too.
units.model: 膜勁度 600 kN/m、初始預應力 3 kN/m，若長期潛變應變 0.3%，預應力流失 Δt = 600×0.003 = 1.8 kN/m，剩 1.2 kN/m，僅為初始值 40%。若在第一年再張拉恢復 0.2% 的伸長，可回升約 1.2 kN/m 至 2.4 kN/m。勁度與潛變量為教學假設。~With fabric stiffness 600 kN/m and initial prestress 3 kN/m, a long-term creep strain of 0.3% loses Δt = 600×0.003 = 1.8 kN/m, leaving 1.2 kN/m, only 40% of the initial value. Re-tensioning in the first year to take up 0.2% of the stretch restores about 1.2 kN/m, back to 2.4 kN/m. Stiffness and creep strain are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 完工後第 6 個月與第 12 個月以相同點位與方法複測膜張力，與完工基準比較，流失超過允許值（例如 30%）即安排再張拉；每次再張拉記錄調整量與結果；定期檢查補片、熱合縫與夾具周邊的磨損。~Re-measure membrane tension at the same points and by the same method six and twelve months after completion, comparing with the baseline and scheduling re-tensioning when the loss exceeds the allowance, for example 30%; record adjustments and results at every re-tensioning; inspect patches, welded seams and wear around clamps periodically.
units.failure: 邊界沒有可調機構，預應力流失後只能任由膜面鬆弛，強風下拍動撕裂，最後被迫整片更換；再張拉時未依分析順序進行，單側過度拉緊使已老化的膜材在角隅撕裂。~Without adjustable boundaries, lost prestress cannot be restored, so the slack membrane flaps and tears in strong wind until the whole panel must be replaced; re-tensioning out of the analysed sequence over-tightens one side and tears aged fabric at corners.
units.misconception: 膜結構完工時預應力正確，就會永久維持。~If a membrane's prestress is right at completion it stays right forever.
units.practice: 設計應提供再張拉機構與可調量，並在維護手冊中列出複測時程、允許流失量、再張拉程序與負責人；再張拉屬張拉作業，須依核准程序並經結構工程師確認。~Design should provide re-tensioning devices with adjustment range, and the maintenance manual should list re-measurement schedule, allowable loss, re-tensioning procedure and responsible party; re-tensioning is tensioning work that requires an approved procedure and confirmation by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 膜屋蓋維護手冊~Membrane-roof maintenance manual
units.title: 除雪門檻、更換規劃與工程交接~Snow-removal thresholds, replacement planning and handover
units.mechanism: 膜屋蓋的營運安全很大程度取決於交接資訊：形狀尋找成果、膜材試驗與補償率、裁片圖與編號、張拉紀錄、完工張力基準、排水與山谷線位置，以及除雪與活動限制。丹佛機場 2003 年雪災與千禧巨蛋 2022 年風損都顯示，局部破損需要快速的臨時保護，而 PTFE 膜備料常需數月到一年，所以業主要事先規劃備料、臨時覆蓋方式與更換程序。~Safe operation of a membrane roof depends heavily on handover information: form-finding results, fabric tests and compensation, cutting patterns and numbering, tensioning records, the as-built tension baseline, drainage and valley-line locations, and snow-removal and activity limits. Denver's 2003 snow damage and the Millennium Dome's 2022 storm damage both show that local failures need fast temporary protection, and since PTFE fabric often takes months to a year to supply, owners must plan spare material, temporary covering and replacement procedures in advance.
units.model: 設計雪載 1.0 kPa、濕雪單位重 2.0 kN/m³，均勻積雪深度上限約 1.0/2.0 = 0.5 m；若山谷線堆積係數為 2.0，局部允許深度只剩約 0.25 m，除雪門檻應以山谷處為準。若雪單位重 1.0 kN/m³（乾雪），均勻深度上限約 1.0 m。數值為教學假設，實際應依設計報告。~With a design snow load of 1.0 kPa and wet-snow unit weight of 2.0 kN/m³, the uniform depth limit is about 1.0/2.0 = 0.5 m; with a drift factor of 2.0 along valley lines, the local allowable depth is only about 0.25 m, so the snow-removal threshold should be set at the valleys. For dry snow at 1.0 kN/m³ the uniform limit is about 1.0 m. Values are teaching assumptions; real limits come from the design report.
units.verify: 交接前由業主、設計者與承包商共同核對文件清單；營運期間依手冊巡檢膜面、夾具、排水與邊索，降雪時量測山谷處積雪深度並與門檻比較；每次更換或修補後更新膜片紀錄與張力基準。~Before handover the owner, designer and contractor jointly check the document list; in operation inspect fabric, clamps, drainage and edge cables per the manual, measure snow depth at valleys during snowfall against the threshold, and update panel records and tension baselines after every replacement or repair.
units.failure: 營運單位不知道除雪門檻與安全的除雪方式，用尖銳工具或在膜上行走除雪，刺破膜材；沒有裁片圖與補償資料，更換膜片時只能重新測繪與試誤，工期拉長且新膜預應力不準。~An operator unaware of snow-removal thresholds and safe methods may clear snow with sharp tools or by walking on the fabric and puncture it; without cutting patterns and compensation data, panel replacement requires re-surveying and trial and error, prolonging the work and leaving the new panel's prestress inaccurate.
units.misconception: 膜屋蓋完工後只需要定期清洗。~Once built, a membrane roof only needs periodic washing.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含形狀尋找與分析模型、膜材試驗報告與補償率、裁片圖、張拉與驗收紀錄、除雪與活動限制、備料與臨時覆蓋方案；任何在膜上的作業與附掛都須經結構工程師核准。~Handover should include the form-finding and analysis models, fabric test reports and compensation, cutting patterns, tensioning and acceptance records, snow-removal and activity limits, and spare-material and temporary-cover plans; any work on or attachment to the membrane requires the structural engineer's approval.

example: 設計練習：一片四點雙曲膜的邊索、補償與敏感度。膜預應力 t = 3 kN/m，自由邊弦長 c = 20 m，邊索張力 T = 150 kN：曲率半徑 R = T/t = 50 m，邊索垂度 f ≈ c²/(8R) = 1.0 m。雙軸試驗得經向勁度 E = 1,000 kN/m，彈性應變 3/1,000 = 0.3%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.5%，20 m 長的裁片裁成 20×0.995 = 19.90 m。若實際膜材較軟（E = 750 kN/m）卻沿用 0.3% 的彈性補償，張拉到同一幾何後預應力只有 750×0.003 = 2.25 kN/m，低 25%；在 T 不變下邊索曲率半徑變為 150/2.25 ≈ 66.7 m、垂度約 0.75 m，邊界幾何也跟著改變，最後需重新調整邊索或桅桿。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。~Design exercise: edge cable, compensation and sensitivity of a four-point anticlastic membrane. With membrane prestress t = 3 kN/m, a free-edge chord c = 20 m and edge-cable tension T = 150 kN, the radius is R = T/t = 50 m and the edge sag f ≈ c²/(8R) = 1.0 m. Biaxial tests give a warp stiffness E = 1,000 kN/m, so the elastic strain is 3/1,000 = 0.3%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.5% compensation, and a 20 m pattern is cut to 20×0.995 = 19.90 m. If the actual fabric is softer, E = 750 kN/m, while the 0.3% elastic compensation is kept, the prestress after tensioning to the same geometry is only 750×0.003 = 2.25 kN/m, 25% low; with T unchanged the edge radius becomes 150/2.25 ≈ 66.7 m and the sag about 0.75 m, so the boundary geometry changes too and edge cables or masts must be readjusted. All values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
history: 現代張拉膜結構的形狀尋找由 Frei Otto 推動：他在 1964 年於斯圖加特大學創立輕量結構研究所，以肥皂膜與實體模型研究極小曲面，並與 Rolf Gutbrod 設計 1967 年蒙特婁世博會德國館。1970 年代的慕尼黑奧運屋蓋促成迭代電腦計算，1974 年發表的力密度法與後來的動態鬆弛法讓形狀尋找與裁片計算成為標準流程。1981 年啟用的吉達哈吉航廈以 210 個 PTFE 玻纖錐形單元覆蓋大面積候機空間，1994 年完成的丹佛國際機場 Jeppesen 航廈則以雙層 PTFE 膜與鋼索構成約 34,800 m² 的主屋頂。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或施工許可。~Form finding for modern tensile membranes was driven by Frei Otto, who founded the Institute for Lightweight Structures at the University of Stuttgart in 1964, studied minimal surfaces with soap films and physical models, and designed the German Pavilion at Expo 67 in Montreal with Rolf Gutbrod. The Munich Olympic roof of the early 1970s prompted iterative computer methods, and the force density method published in 1974, followed by dynamic relaxation, made form finding and patterning standard procedure. The Hajj Terminal in Jeddah, opened in 1981, covered a vast waiting area with 210 PTFE-glass conical units, and Denver International Airport's Jeppesen Terminal, completed in 1994, used double-layer PTFE and steel cables for a main roof of about 34,800 m². This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or construction authorisation.
